Neobrutalist buildings tend to be commissioned by the
private sector, and may use recycled brick or timber rather
than concrete — while still exposing materials and structure.
Many defining aspects have been softened: façades sandblasted
to a stone-like surface, covered in stucco, or made of
patterned precast elements — as in the redevelopment of
Sheffield's Park Hill. But board-marked concrete is still
used, as at the neobrutalist Silberrad Student Centre,
